# MissingGlyphException

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Raised when text uses a character that no registered font can draw and the document's `MissingGlyphs` is `Throw`. With the default, `Drop`, the character is left out and a `Font` warning is recorded instead.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `BonniePdfException`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new MissingGlyphException(IReadOnlyList<int> codePoints, string fontName)
```

## Properties

- [`CodePoints`](#codepoints): The code points no font could draw, up to eight, in the order they were met.
- [`FontName`](#fontname): The font the text asked for.
